list.title: Your Research
list.lede: A Research starts from a question about your customers and collects the feedback you need to answer it.

firstRun.title: Here you keep your questions about customers, with their answers.
firstRun.lede: Start from a question you want answered before a decision. Then collect feedback: a form with a QR code, interview notes, a CSV.

form.label: Your question
form.hint: For example: why don't small teams move to Pro after the trial?

errors.empty: Write the question you want to answer. For example: why don't small teams move to Pro after the trial?
errors.tooLong: The question is over 200 characters: keep it to a single question.
errors.failed: I couldn't save the Research. Try again shortly: your question is still here.
errors.session: Your session has expired. Log in again to continue: copy the text you wrote first, it won't stay here.

header.ledeCount: {count} feedback from {channels, plural, one {1 channel} other {# channels}}, {start} to {end}.
header.ledeEmpty: No feedback yet. The form is on.

notFound.title: I can't find this Research.
notFound.text: It may have been deleted, or the link belongs to another account.

notes.title: Paste the notes of an interview
notes.lede: One interview at a time: one person's notes are one feedback. A message copied from an email or Slack works too: change the channel.
notes.textPlaceholder: The person's words, as you wrote them down
notes.emptyHint: Notes are not saved until you add them.
notes.added: Added to this Research. You'll find them in Feedback.

errors.empty: Paste the notes before adding them.
errors.tooLong: The notes are over 10,000 characters. Keep the parts that report what the person said.
errors.limit: You've reached 100 feedback, the Free plan limit across all your Research: these notes weren't saved.
errors.futureDate: Pick today or a date in the past.
errors.channel: Say where it comes from, at most {limit} characters.
errors.session: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue: copy the text you wrote first, it won't stay here.

synthesis.lede: {count} feedback from {start} to {end}, grouped into {themes} themes.

analyze.label: Analyze {count} feedback
analyze.runningNote: It can take a few minutes. Themes and verdicts show up here as soon as it's done.
analyze.slowNote: This is taking longer than usual. Themes and verdicts will show up here: you can leave the page and come back.
analyze.announcement: Analysis done: {count, plural, one {1 theme} other {# themes}}.
analyze.network: I can't reach Voce. If the analysis had already started, the result shows up here when it's done: reload the page in a few minutes.
analyze.lowFeedbackNote: With fewer than 5 feedback the themes say little: you can analyze them anyway.

cost.one: You'll use 1 of your {limit} analyses for {month}.

changes.line: Since the analysis of {date}: {feedback, plural, one {1 more feedback} other {# more feedback}}, {themes, plural, one {1 new theme} other {# new themes}}.
